青城山上，与神秘的剑客展开了厮杀。.en: Defeated the Masked Duelist's group on the mountain trail. His master remains unnamed. Check the party's gear and training before traveling on.
青城山上，与神秘的剑客展开了厮杀。.zh-CN: 在山道上击退蒙面剑客一伙，幕后主使依然不明。继续上路前，检查伙伴们的装备与研习。

en: A note from Grimm. Let's hope he's the one waiting at his house this time.
"Come see me. Bring your companions ready for trouble, and save your progress before you leave. —Grimm"
Useful instructions. Either he's getting better at letters, or this is a very good forgery.
zh-CN: 格林的信。希望这次在家等我的，真的是他本人。
“来见我。带上准备妥当的伙伴，出发前先保存进度。可能有麻烦。——格林”
总算写了点有用的。要么他写信有长进了，要么这是封高明的假信。

en: Your note said to expect trouble. Please tell me you haven't invited another surprise guest.
A masked swordsman has been seen on the mountain trail. His followers have been asking about you.
The friendly kind of questions?
Mostly threats. I doubt we're being invited to tea.
And that wouldn't fit on the note?
I wanted to explain in person. Also, I wasn't sure how to draw a threatening mask.
Please don't try. I'd spend a week looking for an angry pumpkin.
How far is this mountain?
Far enough that I'd rather take a shortcut. This won't be a practice bout—be ready to fight.
Of course. The shortest route has swords at the end.
Stay close, all of you. Let's find out who's been watching your travels.
zh-CN: 你的信说会有麻烦。别告诉我，你又请了位突然来访的客人。
山道上出现了一名蒙面剑客。他的随从一直在打听你。
友善地打听？
听着更像威胁。恐怕不是请我们去喝茶。
这些话就不能一起写在信上？
我想当面说明。再说，我也不知道怎么画一张凶神恶煞的面具。
那就别画了。我可不想花一周找一颗发怒的南瓜。
这座山有多远？
远得让我宁愿走条捷径。这回可不是练习赛——得准备真正交手。
我就知道。最短的路，尽头总有几把剑。
大家跟紧。我们去看看，到底是谁一直盯着你的旅程。

en: That was quick. My stomach is still back at your house.
It can catch up. Eyes ahead, and keep your companions together.
zh-CN: 真快。我的胃好像还在你家。
它会追上来的。看前面，让伙伴们别走散。

en: Stop there. My master has no use for travelers who ask questions.
Then he's going to hate me. Who sent you?
Our order will take these roads. Stand aside or be buried beside them.
A secret master, an unnamed order, and a mask. You're making introductions difficult.
That sounds like the people behind our uninvited guest. Keep your companions close.
I was hoping his friends would have better manners.
Enough talk. Cut them down!
Stay together—here they come!
zh-CN: 站住。我的主人，不喜欢爱问问题的旅人。
那他肯定会讨厌我。谁派你来的？
这些道路迟早归我们掌握。要么让路，要么埋在路边。
神秘的主人，没名字的组织，再加一副面具。你这自我介绍可真难懂。
听起来，和那位不速之客是一伙的。伙伴们彼此照应。
我还指望他的朋友能更有礼貌些呢。
废话够了。把他们砍倒！
大家别散——他们来了！

en: Not bad. My master will want to hear about you.
Then start with my question. Who are you working for?
(He steps back into the shadows.) You'll know soon enough. Try to stay interesting until then.
He rehearsed the exit more than the answer.
There's room to develop your Steadfast Mastery further. Check its training limit, and get the party ready for the road.
zh-CN: 不错。我的主人会想听听你的事。
那就先回答我的问题。你到底替谁办事？
（他退入暗处。）你迟早会知道。到那时，可别让我觉得无趣。
退场倒是排练得很熟，答案却一个也没准备。
坚毅专精还有继续精进的余地。查看它的研习上限，再把伙伴们准备妥当，继续上路。
